ModMetaData.name: Vampire Lord
ModMetaData.author: Joe McDonagh
ModMetaData.description:
Vampire Lord is a gothic keep tower-defence campaign for RimWorld.
Defend the keep. Read the warning. Prepare the walls. Survive the wave.
M1: Wave Director (warnings, escalating raids, debug controls). M2: Playtest Keep - New Game scenario, 1 Vampire Lord + 2 thralls, simple courtyard, campaign auto-start.
Requires Biotech (Sanguophage lord).
